seriesTitle: The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity

episodes.title: Rintaro and Kaoruko
episodes.summary: While helping at his family's patisserie, Rintaro meets Kaoruko. He fears his appearance has scared her off — but she returns the next day to see him.

episodes.title: Chidori and Kikyo
episodes.summary: Tensions between the two schools escalate during a commotion at Chidori's gates. Later, Rintaro finds a surprise visitor waiting at the patisserie.

episodes.title: A Kind Person
episodes.summary: Desperate to improve their grades, Rintaro and Shohei cram in the library. There, Rintaro runs into Kaoruko, but their tender moment gets interrupted.

episodes.title: Warmth of the Heart
episodes.summary: Though Rintaro becomes more comfortable with Kaoruko during their study session, he faces unexpectedly strong opposition to their growing bond.

episodes.title: Premonition of a New Beginning
episodes.summary: Pressure mounts as Rintaro's friends discover a note from Kaoruko hidden in his notebook. Saku's frustration towards Rintaro's reticence grows.

episodes.title: Self-Loathing / I Love You!
episodes.summary: It's an important night of confessions, apologies and cherished memories when Subaru and Kaoruko catch up at the park where they used to play as kids.

episodes.title: Coolest Guy Ever
episodes.summary: Noticing Rintaro's strange behavior, Shohei, Saku and Ayato follow him after school and try to eavesdrop on his meeting with Kaoruko and Subaru.

episodes.title: The Meaning of These Feelings
episodes.summary: Despite the awkwardness, Rintaro manages to introduce his friends to the girls. Later, Kaoruko makes a bold suggestion on how Rintaro could repay her.

episodes.title: Blond Hair and Pierced Ears
episodes.summary: While Rintaro struggles with his tangled emotions about Kaoruko, he invites his friends over to his home — but two unexpected visitors shake things up.

episodes.title: Summer Storm
episodes.summary: To prepare for their finals, the six Chidori and Kikyo students hold a joint study session. Later, Shohei makes a sharp observation about Rintaro.

episodes.title: A Morsel of Warmth
episodes.summary: Kaoruko's birthday is in two weeks, and Rintaro is unsure of a gift until his mother gives valuable advice. Can he bake the perfect cake for her?

episodes.title: Bewilderment at the Beachside
episodes.summary: While everyone else is having fun at the beach, Subaru seems down. When prodded, she reveals her worries and makes a request to the four Chidori boys.

episodes.title: Kaoruko and Rintaro
episodes.summary: With things still left unspoken between them, Rintaro arranges to meet Kaoruko and express his true feelings. Kaoruko has her own thoughts to share.
